# Weekly Intake Workflow

## Template

Use `05-Assets/Templates/Weekly-Intake-Template.md` for every weekly synthesis.

## Weekly Folder Structure

Each week gets: `02-Intake/Weekly/YYYY-WW/`

Contents:
- Weekly intake file (synthesis)
- Step outputs used that week
- 1-page synthesis capturing main themes
- 3-5 tags mapped to Book Parts and EML layers
- 1-2 candidate diagrams

## Index

Update `02-Intake/Index/Weekly-Intake-Index.md` after each new weekly entry.

## Naming

- Weekly folders: `YYYY-WW` (ISO week)
- Files: `YYYY-MM-DD-<short-descriptor>.md`

## Integration Rules

- Use current weekly knowledge file as context anchor
- Update the knowledge file path when the week changes
- Run full weekly intake template every week to keep Steps 0-7, asset mapping, style notes, and bridge checklist active
- Treat fragmentation as a structural challenge — centralise digestion before branch-level work
